description: U25 rung 6x (LOG 2026-11-24; outside the rules, unranked, no RL), on the 11-25 box (8x H100): D 007's architecture at 1280 x 32 (668M parameters, 64-wide heads, tied embeddings, TinyLlama tokenizer), Muon lr 4e-3 with the fused loss, DDP on 8 GPUs, up to 10.7B tokens (16 per parameter) or 480 minutes, the cosine ending on whichever runs out first. Data in two phases by run progress as in the 3x rung (calibration/research_r121/u25_3x_twophase), except that the FineMath file is keyword-filtered FineMath-4plus shards 0-31 (scripts/research/prep_u25_finemath.sh) instead of shards 0-2. Then the base weights are probed with the 3x rung's probe. Run by scripts/aws/u25_box_item.sh (resume state every 30 minutes; an out-of-memory failure before any state halves the micro-batch). Micro-batch 32: 64 ran out of memory under a 78 GiB cap in the 6x smoke (LOG 2026-11-24 10:21).

u25.weights: $CKPT_DIR/calibration/research_r130/u25_6x/seeds/0/pretrained, copied to the bucket under box/<box>/out/u25/
u25.probe: python scripts/research/probe_reasoning.py --model <weights> --out-dir <this dir>/seeds/0/probe (defaults: sets A,B,C; 200 dev puzzles x 4 samples at temperature 1.0, 256 new tokens; GSM8K 100 train questions 4-shot greedy)
